verdict.rationale: Paychex first-party docs say it offers 401(k) benefits (docs-28) and that benefits can be added inside the same system without moving data (docs-23). A 'Benefit Administration: Recurring Deduction' API use case (docs-9) suggests deductions are tied to payroll. However, nothing explicitly says 401(k) contributions sync automatically with each payroll run. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-payroll automatic 401(k) contribution sync, details on remittance to the plan provider, independent or hands-on corroboration.
